observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && for h in "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/models" "https://api.together.xyz/v1/models"; do echo "=== $h ==="; curl -s --max-time 30 "$h" | python3 -c "
import sys,json
try:
    d=json.load(sys.stdin); ms=d.get('data',d if isinstance(d,list) else [])
    ids=[m.get('id','') for m in ms]
    print('total:',len(ids))
    print('uncensored-ish:',[i for i in ids if any(k in i.lower() for k in ['uncens','ablit','dolphin','hermes','venice','nsfw','unfilter'])][:20])
except Exception as e: print('err',e)
" 2>&1 | head -6; done
